body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Telecommunications America announces that it is working with 20th Century Fox to design a limited release The Simpsons Movie collectible mobile phone and accompanying promotions during 2007 CES uneviled.
It will be Simpsons yellow - inside and out - and feature The Simpsons Movie logo with the words, ‘Special Edition.’ It will also come pre-loaded with exclusive The Simpsons Movie content.
The Simpsons Movie will be launched in America this June or July.
